# Food55

> > Food55 is a recipe website focused on quick, beginner-friendly comfort food with an emphasis on weeknight dinners, one-pot meals, and make-ahead dishes.

The site features practical cooking techniques and time-saving recipes ranging from 5-minute smoothies to 40-minute complete meals. Food55 specializes in American comfort classics, Italian-inspired dishes, and seasonal recipes with clear timing guides and texture-focused instructions.

## Key Topics

- [Soy Sauce Ground Beef and Rice in 20 Minutes](https://food55.com/recipes/soy-sauce-ground-beef-rice): Quick 20-minute soy sauce ground beef stir-fry with ginger and garlic
- [London Broil Marinade Overnight: Tenderize Steak](https://food55.com/recipes/london-broil-marinade): Overnight London Broil marinade for tender steak with cast-iron cooking
- [Piccata Sauce Recipe in 20 Minutes: Silky Finish](https://food55.com/recipes/quick-piccata-sauce-recipe): Italian piccata sauce with cold butter emulsion in 20 minutes
